verdict.rationale: Mailchimp documents a Marketing API with an account-export endpoint, and Transactional webhooks POST per-message open/click events to your own app. Mailchimp also keeps open/click reports, but the evidence shows those only in the UI and never names a reports or metrics API for campaigns or automations. missing for 10: documented campaign reports API endpoints, automation/flow performance metrics via API, confirmation that account exports include performance metrics, independent hands-on corroboration of warehouse/dashboard syncing.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pull campaign and flow performance metrics through the API into my own warehouse or dashboards

citations.quote: Generate a new account export or download a finished account export.
There are three types of webhooks that Mailchimp Transactional currently POSTs: **Message events**: send, deferral, hard-bounce, soft-bounce, delivered, open, click, spam, unsub, reject
Webhooks allow your application to receive information about email events as they occur and respond in a way that you define.
